'''Calaris''' is an open-world [[NPC]] who appears inside the [[Order of the Deep]]'s [[Cathedral of Mercury]], [[Ragunna]]. She's a novice Acolyte and currecntly she's studying Order doctrines.<!--

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(First Interaction)
:'''Calaris:''' O water... O ocean, you are all water...
:{{DIcon}} What are you reciting?
::'''Calaris:''' It's from the Order scripture, Codex of the Deep. Though, that verse I quoted just now... I made it up; it's not in the codex...
:{{DIcon}} O Sentinel, O Sentinel, you—
::'''Calaris:''' Wait! I made up that verse! It's not actually in Codex of the Deep.
:'''Calaris:''' My name is Calaris. I recently joined the Order as a novice Acolyte and am studying Order doctrines...
:'''Calaris:''' The doctrines hold that our world was once an immense ocean, separated by the Sentinel to provide a dwelling for humanity.
:'''Calaris:''' The earthly world was once an immensely deep, boundless ocean where we drifted. Guided by the Sentinel's will, we strive to ascend... hence, the Order's name, Order of the Deep.
:'''Calaris:''' Look, the teachings of the Order are mostly related to water—this is quite understandable.
:'''Calaris:''' The people of Ragunna City live alongside the water, resting upon it as they sleep, yet often needing to confront the threat of the tides.
:'''Calaris:''' Therefore, whether out of love or fear, the people of Ragunna ultimately hold an attitude of reverence towards water.
:'''Calaris:''' But this The Final Tide... what does it mean, exactly...
:'''Calaris:''' People performed rituals, praying to the Sentinel—not only to calm the raging tides but to lead humanity across The Final Tide...
:'''Calaris:''' And some of the stories about the Blessed Maiden... They don't match what I've heard from older folks...
:'''Calaris:''' Oh, so much to learn. I must not have trained enough...
----
;(Second Interaction)
:'''Calaris:''' The Final Tide... what does it mean... and these records about the Blessed Maiden...
:'''Calaris:''' Oh, so much to learn. I must not have trained enough...
{{Dialogue End}}
